'''Erik Stepnitz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]] on 20 July 2001 with TIE deck (Sienar Fleet Systems), according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2716">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-27-guzman-at-comic-con-2001d2716/ guzman-at-comic-con-2001], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 27 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-27-guzman-at-comic-con-2001d2716/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
